title: carthamus gummiferus
intro: Carthamus gummiferus, commonly known as the safflower plant, is a flowering plant in the sunflower family. This plant is used for its edible seeds, which have been traditionally consumed for their potential health benefits. The seeds of Carthamus gummiferus contain various bioactive constituents, including polyunsaturated fatty acids, vitamins, and minerals, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and acting as an antioxidant. The seeds have also been reported to have anti-cancer and anti-diabetic properties, highlighting its potential in promoting overall well-being.
